profile_model_flops: run flops profiling on a PyTorch model with input data to get total FLOPs
profile_model_flops_verbose: run flops profiling on a PyTorch model and print a detailed per-layer profile
get_model_flops_count: get the total FLOPs count for a given model and input data

summarize_get_flops_profile: summarize the get_flops_profile function that measures model FLOPs via flops-profiler
